{{Quote|Oh dear. This is worse than a gravel storm on Tatooine. I hope I'm not dented.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four">''[[Star Wars Science Adventures: Emergency in Escape Pod Four]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Gravel_Storm.jpg|thumb|250px|Gravel storm on Tatooine]]
'''Gravel storms''' were a weather condition found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Whipping rocks, sand, and debris around, they were extremely dangerous to those caught outside. [[U Wanna Wanna]] would close if there was a magnitude four gravel storm on the way.<ref name="Travel Guide">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>
